name: tank_v2
source: session notes; distances NOT re-measured with a tape on this day

case.same_case_as: tank_v1 (63.1/60.1 mm acrylic, 72.95 mm tall, rounded vertical edges, 22.35 mm black base)
case.orientation: UPSIDE DOWN: black base on top, original acrylic top on the stand (silicone curing)
case.pose: corner-on to the projector; face A toward the camera, face B toward the projector side

fill.dye: yellow highlighter extract (fluorescein / pyranine), faint tint
fill.level: liquid spans DMD rows ~850-1095 at the case (row-sweep edges, HEURISTIC)
fill.observed: blue beams fade by about the centre of the case (Joey, by eye)

projector.device: DLP LightCrafter 4500 (EKB 4500 MKII build), stock lens, HDMI video mode 912x1140 at (1920,0)
projector.distance_to_case: moved back from ~406 mm to bring the case inside the 0.5 m minimum focus; exact distance not measured
projector.led_currents: bench R35 G50 B45, unchanged (blue-only frames used)

camera.pose: left of the projector, looking roughly straight through face A (as tank_v1)
camera.filter: none (no long-pass): glow numbers = fluorescence + scatter

pre_run_check: re-project the wide numbered grid and/or re-run the calibration column sweep; silhouettes should stay at ~583 / ~764 and the warp dots should not move. If they do, the case or projector moved: re-map before using fwc_* scenes.
